reserveReview.rationale: The newly published September 2026 agreed-upon-procedures report presents the reserve account at September 30, 2026, 12:31 PM WIB. Its eight balances are ORI030 Rp4,005,850,153; Bank Ina Rp16,740,530,150; Bank Nationalnobu Rp67,784,983; BRI Rp10,244,545; Bank Mandiri Rp10,085,000; Duitku Rp1,604,097,929; PINTU Rp996,226,547; and Indodax Rp706,912,188. They sum exactly to the stated Rp24,141,731,495 reserves, against Rp24,033,769,441 reported circulation. Weights use each exact balance divided by this reserve denominator without decimal rounding. Signed pages 3–4 identify Jojo Sunarjo & Rekan and October 7, 2026, and explicitly disclaim an audit, review or assurance opinion. Report circulation enumerates Base, Polygon, Lisk, Kaia, BSC, Solana and Celo; this reserve allocation does not establish complete current multichain liability coverage. Neither the report nor account balances establish realization horizons, so no immediate-liquidity assumption is carried forward.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Eight institution/instrument balances in the September 30, 2026 AUP complete reserve table, divided by Rp24,141,731,495
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reported reserve balances are identified. The ORI030 underlying depository, enforceable segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation protections, bond contractual maturity and stressed realization horizons are not established. A report-complete reserve table is not a complete current liability census.
